info.prerequisite:
Chuyên ngành BIT_IC: OSG202;
Chuyên ngành BIT_AS: OSG202;
info.description: This course introduces the fundamental concepts and development techniques of Embedded Linux systems. Students learn how to build and configure Linux-based embedded platforms, including cross-compilation toolchains, bootloaders, the Linux kernel, and root file systems. The course also covers system programming concepts, device driver basics, and embedded system debugging techniques. Through hands-on labs and assignments, students gain practical experience in building and deploying custom Embedded Linux systems for embedded devices.
info.studentTasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.

- Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time

- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Promptly access to the FU FLM at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information

materials.materialDescription:
Embedded Linux Primer,
A Practical, Real-World Approach
materials.author: Christopher Hallinan

clos.loDetails: Explain the architecture and components of an Embedded Linux system, including the bootloader, Linux kernel, root filesystem, and hardware abstraction layers.
Configure and use cross-compilation toolchains and development environments to build software for embedded target platforms.
Build, configure, and deploy a customized Embedded Linux system, including kernel configuration, root filesystem creation, and boot process management.
Develop embedded Linux applications using system programming techniques such as file I/O, process management, threading, and inter-process communication.
Apply debugging and performance analysis tools (e.g., GDB, strace, profiling tools) to identify and resolve software issues in Embedded Linux systems.
Design and implement a complete Embedded Linux solution for a target device, integrating system configuration, application development, and testing.
